The '''Peamoney Award''' was an award given to [[Holojournalist/Legends|holojournalists]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Peamoney Award is similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:Peabody Award|Peabody Award]], recognizing excellence in electronic media.
